title: Phase 3 Gate Output Schema
description: Output produced by the Phase 3 gate (tools/bin/phase3_gate.py). Contains per-finding validation results plus gate-level summary. Referenced in skill-sets-framework.md:125. Gate implementation is Session 17+ work — this schema is the contract the gate must satisfy.

gate_verdict.description: PASS = all TPs confirmed by gate, no blocking issues. FAIL = gate found contradicting evidence. REVIEW_REQUIRED = uncertain findings remain.

findings_evaluated.description: Total number of findings processed by gate

findings.description: Gate verdict per finding from phase3-gate-input.

gate_verdict.description: Gate's assessment vs agent verdict. CONFIRMED=agrees with TP. DOWNGRADED=TP→FP or TP→REVIEW. UPGRADED=REVIEW→TP. UNCHANGED=FP or REVIEW not changed. UNCERTAIN=gate cannot determine.

ir_checks_run.description: Which IR checks the gate applied
